11th Level Clan Feature

Your magnetic field constantly slows objects used against you, based on your focus. When you complete a short or long rest, you grant yourself resistance to two of the following damage types from melee and ranged attacks, until you complete a short rest; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, earth or wind.
